title: Central bank net gold purchases (tonnes/year)
notes: 2022 (1,136t) and 2025 (863t) are the World Gold Council's published annual totals. 2010, 2015 and 2018 are conservative round-number estimates consistent with the WGC's cited pre-2022 annual average of 400-500 tonnes; 2024 is a rough interpolation between the 2022 peak and the 2025 confirmed figure.
